name: manual_c3b24d
claim: The correct move to record PT lessons is exactly one command: python3 .agent/tools/learn.py '<your claim>' --rationale '<why this holds>'. That stages, graduates, and re-renders memory/semantic/LESSONS.md automatically. Do not create markdown lesson files by hand under .agent/. Attribution policy should be described with neutral owner-identity labels in memory; actual private identity literals belong only in ignored local config or CI secrets. The defect in the original incident was stale attribution tooling and wrong memory-file procedure, not a reason to preserve private literals in portable memory.

decisions.notes: Corrects the attribution-policy claim using neutral owner-identity labels; the defect was stale attribution tooling plus wrong memory-file procedure, not a reason to retain private literals in memory.

rationale: Redacts derived private-identity fragments from the stale lesson while preserving the durable rule: use the PT memory toolchain and keep attribution policy authoritative through local-only configuration.
